## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_正印 (Metal carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water cross-polarity — precision nourishing and opening intelligence".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Sage: tempered care, nurture with a fine edge of standards. You were shaped by teachings that held you to something, and you shelter others the same way, protection that also sharpens. Knowledge in your keeping stays true. Let some care through unpolished. Warmth needs no proofing."
- k2_functional: "You think in tested doctrine: knowledge kept because it held under strikes."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Detached","Formal","Locked-away"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is armory-grade: fewer books, deeply proofed, instantly deployable. You trust what survived testing. Curate hard, and reread the masters yearly. Your edge is depth.","Shelter":"Your shelter is a forge-side bench: people come to you and leave straightened. You protect by tempering. Remember some visitors need only warmth. Not everything cracked wants rework.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread runs steel-true. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. Where it was missing, you set your own standard. Keep the precision, soften the grading."}

- Sibling cell 金_偏印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Fine-tuned","Selective","Ingenious"],"friction":["Cryptic","Hair-splitting","Shut-in"]}
- Sibling cell 金_偏印 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your mind runs at tolerances other people cannot perceive. The half-degree shift in a colleague’s tone, the number that is slightly off in a healthy report, the note out of place: your instruments register it all, early, while the dashboard still shows green."

Core element Water, energy element Metal. Law: Metal feeds Water (金生水: dew beads on the cold blade). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Metal is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Metal on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Metal as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Whatever you are told stays with you. Being a safe place is how you know you matter, so you keep a confidence rather than ever use it. Let someone keep one of yours in return, because you wear thin with nothing kept for you.

value_b.text: A confidence stays kept with you. You would rather be the one people trust than the one with news, and nothing told to you ever leaves your keeping. Let one trusted person carry a little of it, and the keeping gets lighter without getting looser.

value.text: Keeping a confidence means carrying it. You hold what people tell you rather than talk it through with anyone, and the weight of other lives sits on your own rest. Give one of them to a notebook, and you keep the trust and the sleep.

value.text: You keep your own troubles as closely as everyone else's. You would rather hold things than need holding, and you give the ones who tell you everything nothing of yourself back. Once you hand one of them a worry, the shelter becomes shared.

value.text: You learn a thing properly or not at all. Half-knowing a subject bothers you more than not knowing it, so you go to its end before counting it learned. When you take the slow way on purpose, what you learned stays true under pressure.

value_b.text: Learning it properly is the only way you trust it. You would rather finish one subject than start ten, and that keeps your list short. When you start the next one early, that sure footing comes with you.

value.text: Learning it properly takes you longer. Knowing a thing to its end matters to you more than knowing it well enough, and most chances ask for less. Once you take one door on less than the whole, you stop watching chances go to faster people.

value.text: Teaching waits until you have learned it properly. You would rather pass a subject on whole than in pieces, and the people learning from you get nothing before the whole arrives. The more you teach as you learn, the less knowledge you keep from them.

value.text: You steady people by holding them to something. Keeping someone safe matters more to you than keeping them comfortable, so your care arrives as a standard rather than a hug. When you put the warm word before the rule, your steadying lands as love.

value_b.text: Steadying someone is the shape your love takes. You trust a standard more than a soft word to hold a person up, and the people leaning on you stand straighter. Let one lean without a lesson, and you keep them close as well as upright.

value.text: Steadying people earns you respect ahead of closeness. Being needed when things fall apart suits you more than being phoned for nothing, and the no-reason calls are what you miss. Once you rest the standard an evening, you get the closeness it stands in for.

value.text: Whenever someone arrives to be held, you steady them instead. A standard feels more useful to you than a kind word, and you hand the one who came for comfort a lesson. Each time you ask what they need first, you keep the steadying wanted.
